From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Steering committee: exec sponsor + agenda for FinIntegrate rollout

Hi Sara -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the steering committee on the calendar:

Recap (from discovery):
- Primary use case: embeddings + chat for customer support automation (pilot scope: 50k monthly chats).
- Key decision criteria: output accuracy on financial domain, SLA (p95 latency), and predictable unit cost.
- Security asks: SOC 2 in-scope evidence, network isolation options, and KMS/HSM support.
- Procurement timeline: target Q4 PO (your note: internal approvals in mid-Oct).

Who should attend the steering committee (30-45 min):
- Exec sponsor (economic buyer) - we recommend CFO or head of product.
- Head of Security / InfoSec (to validate SOC/KMS questions).
- Procurement (to map contract and PO process).
- Product/Eng tech lead (to confirm integration constraints).

Can you confirm the exec sponsor and security/procurement contacts?

Proposed times (PDT) next week - please pick one:
- Thu 17 Sep, 11:00-11:45am
- Thu 17 Sep, 2:00-2:45pm
- Fri 18 Sep, 9:00-9:45am

Attached: draft agenda and SOC2 checklist for your review. I can share a short one-pager for the CFO that highlights unit economics and committing options if that helps.

If we lock a time, I'll send a calendar invite and a short slide deck for the steering committee.

Thanks - looking forward to getting exec alignment.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Thanks for the clear recap. Happy to move this forward. Quick answers:

- Security/InfoSec: Lydia Chen (lydia.chen@fintegrate.com) - she asked for the SOC 2 report and details on KMS options; she's available if you want to loop her into the steering committee.
- Procurement: procurement@fintegrate.com handles PO and standard T&Cs; typical PO cadence is Net30 but they'll confirm after exec alignment.

I'll have procurement and Lydia join. If you can send a one-pager for James that highlights pricing scenarios (pilot vs committed) that would be great.
